name: Best-AI.org

sources.title: Best-AI.org - Submit Tool ('Free Submission', 1-2 weeks review, 'Free Forever')
Best-AI.org - How We Review (linked from footer)
Best-AI.org homepage - 4,200+ AI tools, 17 categories, editorial review

requirements: AI tools only - the directory covers image generation, writing, code assistance, video, productivity, conversational AI, AI agents, etc.
Submission is free ('Free Submission', 'Free Forever' stated on the submit page)
Flow: 'Submit Details -> We Review -> Go Live' - the team 'verifies and enriches' listings; stated review time is 1-2 weeks
Run by BitAutor (Hannover, Germany, HRB 218756) - a real editorial operation with published methodology and editorial guidelines
preparation: Features list and pricing information (the submit flow asks for 'tool's info, features, and pricing')
Category fit within their ~17 AI categories
workflow: Fill in the tool's info, features, and pricing (form fields render on-page)
Submit - the team verifies and 'enriches' the listing editorially
Wait 1-2 weeks for review; the tool goes live in its category once approved
watchFor: Editorial enrichment means your copy may be rewritten/extended - provide accurate, publishable details
No paid fast lane advertised on the submit page - the free path is the only one shown
AI-assistance disclosure: some site content is 'created with AI assistance and reviewed by our editorial team' - your listing description may be partly machine-drafted
The directory pages separate 'Open Source AI', 'Top 100', and by-country views - a live listing may surface in several
countsAsLive: The tool has a public detail page on best-ai.org and appears in its category/search
unknowns: Exact required fields inside the form (partially JS-rendered)
Whether the outbound link is dofollow
Rejection criteria beyond the stated review
